items.title: Use of Machine Learning In Education (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Use of Machine Learning In Education' under topic 6.5 (PDF 81, printed 77).

blocks.text: Taleem mein machine learning seekhne ke systems behtar banati hai. Yeh talaba ki performance par nazar rakhne mein madad deti hai taake un ke grades behtar hon. Har talib-e-ilm ko us ke mutabiq (personalized) parhai ka mawad milta hai. Hazri (attendance) aur assessment (jaanch) ke systems zyada smart ho jate hain, aur seekhne ke nataij behtar hote hain.
